paite: Ka tung gikna mai e: nipi thei a sek khawm hun laia om bang leh grep loh hun laia grep maiah loh ding bang lah ka hi ngala: gah bom nek nek ding a om kei; ka hinnain theipi min masa a lunggulh hi.
english: Misery is mine! Indeed, I am like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard: There is no cluster of grapes to eat. My soul desires to eat the early fig.

paite: Pathian limsakmi lei a kipan a mang ua, mihing lakah mi diktak mahmah a om kei uh: sisan suah dingin a tang vek ua; mi chihin amau unau lenin a gem uhi.
english: The godly man has perished out of the earth, and there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; every man hunts his brother with a net.

paite: A khutte uh thil hoihlou tunga thanuam taka hih dingin a nga ua; kumpipan a ngena, vaihawmpan a phuta; mi lianin a lungsim thil hihkhelhna a gen khiaa: huchibang in a kithutuak uhi.
english: Their hands are on that which is evil to do it diligently. The ruler and judge ask for a bribe; and the powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul. Thus they conspire together.

paite: A lak ua mi hoihpen loulingnei bang ahi a; mi dik pen leng dai ling nei sangin a hoih kei jaw: nang vengmite ni, veha na om ni ngei a hongtung hi; huai bel a mangbat ni uh ahi ding.
english: The best of them is like a brier. The most upright is worse than a thorn hedge. The day of your watchmen, even your visitation, has come; now is the time of their confusion.

paite: Lawm ah muang kei unla, makai mi ah leng ginna koih kei un: na angsunga omnu akipanin na kam kongkhakte hoih takin vengin.
english: Don’t trust in a neighbor. Don’t put confidence in a friend. With the woman lying in your embrace, be careful of the words of your mouth!

paite: Tapain pa min a hihsiaa, tanuin a nu a dou a, mou-in a pi a dou ngal a; mihing melmate jaw amah inkote mah ahi uh.
english: For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; a man’s enemies are the men of his own house.

paite: Ken jaw TOUPA lam ka en dinga; ka hotdamna Pathian ka ngak ding; ka Pathianin a honngaikhe sin ahi.
english: But as for me, I will look to Yahweh. I will wait for the God of my salvation. My God will hear me.

paite: Aw ka melma, honawi ken: ka puk hun chiangin ka thou nawn ding; miala ka tut in leng TOUPA kei din vak ahi ding.
english: Don’t rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.

paite: TOUPA tunga thil ka hih khelh jiakin, a lunghihlouhna mahmah ka po ding, ka tung thu a hongen piha, kei dia vaihawmna a tangtun ma siah; vakah a honpi khe dinga, huan, diktatna ka mu ding.
english: I will bear the indignation of Yahweh, because I have sinned against him, until he pleads my case, and executes judgment for me. He will bring me forth to the light. I will see his righteousness.

paite: Huchiin ka melma ka kianga, TOUPa na Pathian koiah, chipan huai a mu dinga, zahlaknam amah a tuam ding. Ka miten amah a en ding a: tun jaw kongzing buannawi banga sikden a hita ding.
english: Then my enemy will see it, and shame will cover her who said to me, where is Yahweh your God? Then my enemy will see me and will cover her shame. Now she will be trodden down like the mire of the streets.

paite: Na kulh bangte bawlna ni ding: huai ni chiangin thusehpen gamlapi phaa zatsak ahi ding.
english: A day to build your walls— In that day, he will extend your boundary.

paite: Huai ni chiangin Assuria gam leh Aigupta khopi akipan te, Aigupta leh Lui pha hiala kipan te, tuipi leh tuipi kikal akipan te leh tang leh tang kikal akipan tein na kiangah a hongpai ding uh.
english: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea, and mountain to mountain.

paite: Huchi piin leng gam, a sunga tengte jiak leh a thilhih gah uh jiakin hihgam ahi ding.
english: Yet the land will be desolate because of those who dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings.

paite: Karmel tang kala gamnuaia lungjuang taka om na gou tan belam hon, na mite na khetbuk zangin vak inla: nidang lai bangin Basan leh Gilead ah vakin om chiat uhen.
english: Shepherd your people with your staff, the flock of your heritage, who dwell by themselves in a forest, in the midst of fertile pasture land, let them feed; in Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old.

paite: Aigupta gam akipana na pai khiak lai bangin a kiang ah thillamdang mahmah te ka en sak ding.
english: “As in the days of your coming forth out of the land of Egypt, I will show them marvelous things.”

paite: Nam chihin huai a mu ding ua, a thilhihtheihna tengteng uh a zumpih ding uh: a muk uh a hum ding ua, a beng uh a ngong ding.
english: The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be deaf.

paite: Gul bangin leivui a liak ding ua; khupboha paite bangin a omna kua ua kipanin ling kawmin a hongpai ding uh: TOUPA i Pathian kiangah laudansiam kawmin a hongpai ding ua, nang jiakin a lau ding uh.
english: They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth they shall come trembling out of their dens. They will come with fear to Yahweh our God, and will be afraid because of you.

paite: Nang banga thulimlouhna ngaidampa leh a goutan om sun tatlekna nelhsiahpa Pathian kua a oma? a hhna khantawnin a vom gige kei, hehpihna a a kipah mahmah sek jiakin.
english: Who is a God like you, who pardons iniquity, and passes over the disobedience of the remnant of his heritage? He doesn’t retain his anger forever, because he delights in loving kindness.

paite: A kilehhei nawn dinga, i tungah hehpihna a nei ding; i thulimlouhnate a khe nuaiah a sikden ding; nang amau khelhna tengteng tuipi taw thukpi ahte na pai lut ding.Nidang laia ka pu te uh pute kianga na kichiamsa, Jakob kianga thutak leh Abraham kianga hehpihna na tangtun ding hi.
english: He will again have compassion on us. He will tread our iniquities under foot; and you will cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

paite: Nidang laia ka pu te uh pute kianga na kichiamsa, Jakob kianga thutak leh Abraham kianga hehpihna na tangtun ding hi.
english: You will give truth to Jacob, and mercy to Abraham, as you have sworn to our fathers from the days of old.
